title: Cook's membrane benchmark (TL × J2 × Hex8)
objective: Run the Cook's membrane benchmark on the existing TL + J2 + Hex8 reference path and assert the mean tip displacement stays within 2% of the committed Hex8 regression value for the de Souza Neto load case.
scope: Wrap the existing TL + J2 + Hex8 Cook's membrane regression in `mechdsl.verify.benchmarks.run_cook_membrane_benchmark`.
Use the de Souza Neto load case on the locked 2x2x1 Hex8 mesh and compare the mean tip displacement against the committed reference.
Assert Newton convergence at every load step and preserve the legacy Cook regression path.
implementation_steps: Add a reusable Cook's membrane harness under `packages/mechdsl-core/src/mechdsl/verify/benchmarks/` with dependency injection for the handwritten plastic solver.
Replace the stubbed task test with a TL + J2 + Hex8 benchmark test that reaches the new public harness.
Keep the existing legacy benchmark in `tests/test_benchmarks.py` passing so the new harness does not fork the reference behavior.
acceptance_criteria: TL + J2 + Hex8 mean tip displacement matches the committed Cook reference within 2%.
Newton-Raphson converges at every load step on the locked Cook benchmark setup.

cases: Legacy Cook regression in `tests/test_benchmarks.py` remains green

risks: Cook's membrane is mesh-sensitive. Mitigation: lock the regression to the existing 2x2x1 Hex8 mesh, total shear 100 N, and 10 load steps used by the committed reference value.
completion_notes: User approved a rescope from the original 4-cell matrix (TL/UL x Hex8/Tet10) to the executable TL + J2 + Hex8 benchmark slice.
Added `run_cook_membrane_benchmark` and `CookMembraneParameters` to the public benchmark harness surface, following the same dependency-injection pattern as the other Phase 10 benchmarks.
Replaced the task stub file with two real regression tests: 2/2 passed through the new public harness, and the legacy Cook benchmark stayed green at 4/4 passed.

Additional verification: `uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/test_phase6_exit.py -v` -> 9/9 passed; `uv run mypy packages/mechdsl-core/src/mechdsl/verify/benchmarks` -> success; `uv run ruff check packages/mechdsl-core/src/mechdsl/verify/benchmarks packages/mechdsl-core/tests/test_benchmarks_cook_membrane_matrix.py` -> clean.
